evidence.scope: Original layout inspection preceding the authored standard and corner candidates. This historical inspection earns no art stage.

evidence.scope: Metadata counts and category estimates. No authored or visible coverage is inferred.
evidence.title: Complete serialized inventory

evidence.scope: Owned bark and endgrain fit the exact log material. Both quality candidates have scoped UV, native payload and original-material render evidence. Companion normals, world integration and final approval remain open.

evidence.scope: Three authored albedos have scoped UV and native texture evidence across seven retained meshes. Distant bark conflict, unhealthy sapling state, companion normals, actual shader, wind and LOD transitions remain open. No beech game or final approval.

evidence.scope: Owned HD and Balanced cutouts fit seven shared consumer uses. Native material comparisons and scoped UV review pass; distant appearance, world binding and final approval remain open.

evidence.scope: Owned 1024px and 512px opaque surfaces for one exact flint material. All five retained mesh layouts have scoped UV and native comparison evidence. Nine texture-sharing emission materials are excluded. World, distance and final art review remain open.
evidence.title: Flint surface candidates

evidence.scope: Bounded grass material ownership and asynchronous sampler handling pass isolated native fixtures. These runtime checks add no inventory completion stages.
evidence.title: Grass ownership and texture sampler checks

evidence.scope: Tall and short grass plus continuous bark and stump candidates have scoped UV and native texture evidence. HD grass also passes an isolated original-shader instancing fixture. Wind, world integration, distance transitions and final approval remain open.
evidence.title: Meadows grass and material-specific beech bark

evidence.scope: Owned 512px and 256px opaque atlases fit the retained fruit, stem and calyx. Native material evidence covers two representative transforms. Original normal remains an unapproved comparison control; world, distance and final art review are open.
evidence.title: Raspberry fruit candidates

evidence.scope: Two authored cutouts pass scoped top-facing roof UV review and native BC3 mip sampling. Three original roof meshes retain geometry and companion slots. Actual game shader, underside, weather, LOD and final approval remain pending.

evidence.scope: The exact granite_hd_albedo, timber_hd_albedo and roof_atlas_hd_albedo replacements passed native texture sampling. No mesh streaming claim.

evidence.scope: Explicit serialized mesh ID, renderer hierarchy, topology and slot order establish the retained roof geometry used by the menu fixture.
evidence.title: Exact original roof fixture identity

evidence.scope: Three isolated original roof submeshes use the fitted atlas. Companion faces, assembled roofs and native shaders are outside this UV review.
evidence.title: 67-degree roof atlas UV review

evidence.scope: 35 checks passed with an owned diagnostic shader, including stored-float and keyword state checks, asynchronous ownership and complete drain. The installed game is unchanged. This does not validate the new fringe texture, original game shader or mesh streaming.
evidence.title: Staged cutout adapter native checks

evidence.scope: Blender albedo review on the original Rock_3_Untitled and pole meshes, with retained UVs and material transforms. No native game shader claim.
evidence.title: Stone and timber UV review

evidence.scope: Historical initial standard candidate and ordinary mip limitation. The later Meadows straw review records corrected compressed mips, UV layout and native sampling.
evidence.title: Authored standard straw-fringe candidate

stage_definitions.approved: Explicit final approval recorded for the stated scope.
stage_definitions.authored: An authored replacement is explicitly mapped to this original asset.
stage_definitions.game_fixture_validated: Identified replacement or retained mesh participated in the cited game fixture.
stage_definitions.inventoried: Unique serialized original asset metadata recorded.
stage_definitions.native_validated: Identified authored replacement passed the cited native loading or sampling check.
stage_definitions.uv_reviewed: Authored appearance reviewed on identified original mesh UVs, within cited scope.

status_semantics: False means no matching completion evidence is recorded. Stages are independent and scoped; inventory is not visible replacement coverage.
